For me, it felt a lot like how the Dokdo Lotion felt on my skin, where is just sat on top with that sticky/tacky feel. And I've read reviews that says it dries quickly with no stickiness. So, it is possible that this just doesn't work for my skin type. I also think my skin reacted with one or some of the ingredients since I put it on one night and woke up with little tiny pimples on my face. So, it could also be that it just didn't work for me personally.

avis.titre: Hyaluronic acid is one of the holy grails in my routine
avis.texte: Hyaluronic acid is one of the holy grails in my routine, so when I saw this Round Lab ampoule up for grabs I got it. The consistency is decently thick and doesnt leave my face sticky. I wet my hands before applying to activate the HA. The product is scentless and mixes well with harsher serums like retinol and lactic acid.

This ampoule is very moisturizing and lightweight. I like that you can layer this ampoule without it getting too heavy and would recommend this product for those who have dry and/or sensitive skin. The product is gentle enough to use daily as I apply it both during the day and night time and it helps to relieve any irritation/redness in my skin after using it, especially when I pair it with the other round lab products in the line. For those who have oily skin, this could serve well as a daily moisturizer with a couple of layers especially if you live in a hotter climate. The texture feels very light and the product is viscous but not too much so it is very easily spreadable. For days I feel extra dry, I mix the ampoule and the moisturizing cream from the same line(you can use any soothing cream you have on hand) for an extra boost of moisture(learned this hack from EuniUnni on Youtube). There is no scent to this product and it helps soothe the skin as well since this ampoule has a nice cooling effect and absorbs fairly quickly into the skin. Would love to buy this again. The only downside to this is the packaging because the dropper has a hard time sucking up product.

avis.titre: The Round Lab 1025 Dokdo line is a special line
avis.texte: The Round Lab 1025 Dokdo line is a special line that uses minimal ingredients and is suitable for sensitive skin. It also commemorates Dokdo Day on October 25; hence the name 1025 Dokdo. Products in this line use deep sea water from Dokdo islands which is said to contain 74 types of minerals that help balance skins water and oil levels. The Water Ampoule is highly concentrated but remains extremely gentle. It uses Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid which has a low molecular weight so it is able to penetrate skin better and deliver hydration and moisture to the inner layers. Highlighted ingredients are Panthenol, Betaine, and Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate (Licorice). There is also Glycerin, Ceramide NP, Vitamin E in the form of Tocopherol, Hydrolyzed Collagen, and other good-for-the-skin ingredients. It doesnt contain alcohol, fragrance, nor essential oils. The ampoule has a gel texture that turns into water when spread. Its marketed as a hydration booster and I find it very effective in making skin look plump and nourished. This product is highly rated on Korean skincare apps and it lives up to the hype. It definitely soothes and gives instant relief to dry skin, also calms and reduces redness on my cheeks so skin looks clear and brighter. If I get inflamed skin, I believe Il be able to use this without fear of stinging or further irritation.

avis.titre: The round lab 1025 Dokdo ampule hydrates, moisturizes, calms
avis.texte: The round lab 1025 Dokdo ampule hydrates, moisturizes, calms and soothes skin. This moisturizing soothing ampule containing low molecular weight hyaluronic acid, hydrates dry skin and comfortably protects skin from external environmental stressors. The combination of the deep sea water of clean Ulleungdo island and low molecular weight hyaluronic acid keeps skin hydrated and moisturized. Fine particles of low molecular weight collagen and aqua ceramides are effectively absorbed and help keep the skins barrier strong. This product was specifically designed for sensitive skin and does not have any fragrance or added colors. Dokdo uses Ulleungdos clean deep-sea water which includes rich mineral components that helps to sooth and moisturize irritated skin caused by external environmental stressors. It has a thin gel-water consistency that absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any sticky or greasy residue behind. I use it after cleansing and toning my skin. I love that it contains ceramides and collagen but is also fragrance-free. It did not irritate my skin at all. It actually left it plump, smooth and hydrated. I have been using this along with the 1025 Dokdo cleanser and I am loving the results. It is dermatologist tested.
